run_tracking_service: run the SAM2 tracking server as a ZMQ REP service on port 21002
create_Track_instance: create a Track instance that initializes the SAM2 video predictor with a checkpoint
track_object_with_bbox: track an object across video frames using Track init_state, add_bbox, and track methods
call_tracking_with_socket: call tracking_with_socket to send images and a bounding box to the tracking server via ZMQ
visualize_segmentation_masks: visualize segmentation masks on frames using the Track vis method and show_mask helper
